The density of sea water is 1030kg/m3.
The gravitational field strength on the Earth is 9.8N/kg.
Atmospheric pressure is 101000Pa.
At which depth in sea water is the total pressure due to the atmosphere and the water equal to
513000Pa?
A
40.8m
B
50.8m
C
400m
D
498m
subject: Physics
